claims.summary: For an F_p degree-D pseudoideal containing old Boolean or F_p domains, fixed weight w of degree<=b, F_p-linear U<=V_K and actual F_p errors E_i of degree<=e, b+K+e+(p-1)min(K,e)<=D makes the generic pencil sum t_i(f->[wE_i f]) have exactly the stacked common kernel and rank r. Input-side Frobenius gives b+K+pe; multiplier-side p-power independence gives b+pK+e without powering w. Over any finite extension of cardinality q>r, a uniform specialization has the same kernel with probability>=1-r/q. If r<dim[wU], an original F_p multiplier in U survives and kills every error. This is a cheaper compression window, not a new joint-rank upper bound or an extension-valued scalar ENS substitution.

In the actual degree-e+2 PC closure of the same generators z is derivable and all four error products vanish. This is a satisfiable truncated-action control, not a hard-source family.
